transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Um, well, I came in today because I just... I keep beating myself up lately. I got promoted to a senior analyst role a while back, but I just feel like I'm not really senior material. Like I somehow fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I actually can. It's just been weighing on me a lot.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day lately?

Yeah, I have. Most days lately, honestly. I've just had this... this heavy, low feeling. It's like I'm just moving through work and then going home, but everything just feels like the color has been turned down. Just very flat and down most of the day.
How long have you been feeling this low most days?
Well, looking back... I guess these low, guilty periods have been hanging around off and on for about eleven months now. It's just been a while.
Did these feelings begin after a specific stressful event, such as your promotion or increased responsibilities at work?

Yeah, I think so. The noticeable up-and-down pattern really started about a month ago, right after they asked me to start covering those senior analyst duties. That's when I really started noticing the shifts.
During this period, have you lost interest in or enjoyment of activities that you usually like?

Yeah, I have. Usually, I really look forward to grilling out on the weekends, maybe doing a little fishing, or just putting on a record to unwind. But lately... I don't know, I just leave all my gear sitting there. I just don't really care to do any of it right now.
How has your energy been lately?

It's been pretty low, honestly. By the time I get home from the office... I don't know, even simple things like checking the mail or loading the dishwasher just feel like way more effort than they should. I just feel wiped out.
How has your sleep been lately?

It hasn't been great, honestly. I'm either waking up way too early—my brain just starts going over client tickets and I can't fall back asleep—or, even if I do manage to get enough hours in, I still wake up feeling completely worn out.
Have you had any thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't made any plans to actually hurt myself or anything like that. But... I don't know, I do catch myself thinking sometimes that it might just be easier if I didn't wake up some morning.
Do these low mood and loss-of-interest symptoms affect areas of your life outside of work and the promotion?

Yeah, I'd say so. I mean, I'm still making it to work every day, but I've had to double-check myself a lot more just to make sure I'm not messing things up. And outside of that... yeah, I've definitely pulled back from my friends and family. I just don't really trust my mood or my judgment lately, so it's easier to just keep to myself.
Have you had a continuous period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or lost interest in things nearly every day?

Yeah, definitely longer than two weeks. Um, looking back at it... these low periods, where I just feel down and kind of guilty about everything, they've actually been hanging around off and on for about eleven months now. So it's been a while.
During that stretch of at least two weeks, were you feeling depressed or uninterested in things nearly every day?

Yeah, I would say so. Most days lately, I've just had this... this heavy, low feeling. It's like I'm just moving through my workday and then going home, but everything feels kind of muted, like the color has been turned down on everything. It's pretty much every day.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite recently?

Yeah, my appetite has definitely been off. Um, I've mostly just been grabbing a few bites here and there, or sometimes I'll just skip supper altogether. I haven't really been trying to lose weight or anything, but I have noticed my belt is fitting a little looser lately.
How much have your mood and other symptoms interfered with your ability to function at work, at home, or in your relationships?

Well, I'm still making it to work every day, but it's definitely taking a toll. I find myself having to double-check my work a lot more than I usually do, just to make sure I'm not missing anything. And at home... I've really pulled back from my friends and family. I just don't trust my mood or my judgment right now, so it's easier to just keep to myself.
Do you experience these depressive symptoms even on days when you are not thinking about or dealing with work?

Yeah, it's pretty much the same on the weekends, too. Even when I'm not dealing with work or thinking about it, I still have that heavy, muted feeling. It doesn't seem to matter if I'm at the office or just sitting at home on a Saturday... it's just kind of always there right now.
